thread:
mira: Heads-up: planned terraform apply tonight at 23:30 UTC for staggered route table updates + small IAM role tweak for billing-exporter. This will be a canary + two-wave rollout. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/route-iam-cutover. Please ack availability.

noah: I can monitor for the first 45m. What's the exact abort criteria?

mira: Abort if: sustained 5xx > 1% for 3m, route propagation errors > 20 in 5m, or failed assume-role tests. We'll also watch connection count to peering.

tess: I'll run the eu-canary (eu-central-1) and smoke auth/metrics. I'll save plan json to the tf-plans bucket before apply.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled apply 1717504321 by @mira. Canary: eu-central-1 -> wave1: us-west-2 -> wave2: us-east-1. Provider pinned: hashicorp/aws = 3.5.2. State snapshot path: s3://redwood-tf-state/backups/network/1717504321.tfstate

ops-bot: Remote state lock obtained by mira (lock id: c3d7e1). TTL: 50m.

tess: Canary apply started. I'll post smoke results in ~10m.

deploybot: deploybot: canary apply running (eu-central-1). Logs: https://deploy-logs.internal/1717504321/canary

tess: Canary done. Smoke OK, assume-role tests passed. One route table entry updated, propagation complete. No 5xx.

noah: Dashboards look stable. Proceed with wave1 in 8m. I'll be on pager.

mira: Reminder: preflight commands in the runbook: `terraform plan -out=planned.tfplan && terraform show -json planned.tfplan > planned.json && aws s3 cp planned.json s3://redwood-tf-plans/`

deploybot: deploybot: wave1 apply succeeded. wave2 queued to start in 10m.

tess: Wave2 started.

deploybot: deploybot: wave2 apply completed. All waves finished.

noah: Post-apply checks: verified route tables and peering status. `aws ec2 describe-route-tables` shows expected targets. IAM assume-role tests green.

mira: Rollback note added to runbook: abort remaining waves, restore state from the pre-run snapshot, and reopen PR revert if terraform state restore is needed. Also include emergency contact list.

ops-bot: Snapshot saved and compressed at s3://redwood-tf-state/backups/network/1717504321.tfstate.gz. Lock released.

mira: Thanks all. I'll file a short release note and attach the plan JSON.

tess: Nice and smooth. Closing thread.
